reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 4 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Raptors.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Knicks (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Knicks win 62 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 190 and 238 total points.
